gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. The Scorebar page describes the eight fixed scorebar cells by simple settings (colour, blend, rounding, border, opacity, an optional picture), previews them on a drawn field with stand-in text, and writes a template folder that the existing static scorebar compiler installs. It never enables an option by itself: Use in Build only fills the Build tab's scorebar folder field.

input_constraints: Writes only a user-chosen folder: layout.json copied from the preset's contract, 1x/ and 2x/ PNGs, images/ copies of chosen pictures and scorebar_studio.json. The shipped reference kit is refused as a save target.

Every saved folder is compiled by nfl2k5_scorebug_template.compile_folder before the page reports success: at most the chosen colour limit (default 128, hard limit 256) across all layers, exact tile sizes, unchanged cell contract.
Pictures are fitted in on-screen proportions and reduced to the atlas tile; a layer that is exactly a template PNG with no other settings is written back byte for byte.
One bar for every team; team colours in the preview are preview only. Live text, possession colour and timeouts are drawn by the game and cannot be changed here.
The game slot figure on the page is an estimate from the optimal VC-LZ encoder with a fixed header allowance; the build's exact fixed-span check remains the authority.
portme: Apply the Scorebar Studio section of WIRING.md: the Scorebar navigation row, the folder_chosen connection, allowlist lines and the runtime closure imports.
Complete Noah's witness list in FABLE_SCOREBUG_STUDIO_REPORT.md; no built disc has been watched in-game with a Studio-made bar.

public_distribution.rule: Ship the model, the page, the preset registry and the guide. Presets reference only the shipped reference kit's PNGs. No retail texture, disc, pack or executable is read or bundled.

runtime.scope: Offline only. The saved folder compiles through the proved static scorebar compiler and the preview is a software raster on a drawn field. No native, emulator or gameplay evidence exists for a Studio-made bar.

fields.name: scorebug
fields.allowed: boolean; the existing static scorebar option must be on for the folder to be used

fields.name: scorebug_folder
fields.allowed: a folder saved by the Scorebar page (or any valid template folder)

selectors.notes: The page emits folder_chosen(str); the shell writes it into the Build tab's existing scorebug_folder_field. The existing template capability owns the install.

source_container.format: XBE plus fixed SCNE/TXTR in XDVDFS pack 0, through the existing template installer
source_container.resource: score_buga atlas through nfl2k5.scorebug_presentation.template; the Studio itself reads no game data
source_container.retail_file: user-owned USA default.xbe and vc_53450030/0 at build time only
